chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as Allah’s exclusive attribute, distinguishing His essential nature from created entities. This highlights the Shia theological emphasis on *Tawhid al-Sifat*, affirming that all perfection and goodness originate solely from the Divine, thereby reinforcing the believer’s *Tawakkul* (trust) in God’s ultimate wisdom despite apparent adversities.
